customManagers.description: Versions pinned as Dockerfile ARGs with a '# renovate:' comment
Git extensions pinned by commit: a release branch head (git-refs) or a release tag (git-tags)

packageRules.description: MediaWiki: stay on 1.46; the move to 1.47 LTS is a manual change (REL1_47 branches, SMW support)
MediaWiki 1.46.x patch releases: automerge once the release is 3 days old and the build and smoke checks passed on the PR

Extension commits on the release branch: automerge once the build and smoke checks passed on the PR. git-refs has no release timestamps, so the 3-day age applies only where Renovate knows it (timestamp-optional; 'required' would hold these PRs forever)
SMW and SRF: always a reviewed PR (read the release notes; minor versions change the image tag)
MySQL: the floating 8.4 tag already follows patches (Watchtower); never propose 9.x innovation releases
